relations.subject: Gordon Johnson
relations.evidence: Johnson was educated at Richmond School in North Yorkshire and Trinity College, Cambridge.

relations.subject: Gordon Johnson
relations.evidence: He was a fellow at Trinity from 1966 to 1974

relations.subject: Gordon Johnson
relations.evidence: and at Selwyn College from 1974 to 1993.

relations.subject: Gordon Johnson
relations.evidence: He was appointed as a lecturer in Oriental studies at the University of Cambridge in 1974, remaining in that position until 2005.

relations.subject: Gordon Johnson
relations.evidence: He was the President of Wolfson College, Cambridge, from 1993 to 2010

relations.subject: Gordon Johnson
relations.object: Cambridge University Centre of South Asian Studies
relations.evidence: He was the Director of the Cambridge University Centre of South Asian Studies from 1983 to 2001

relations.subject: Gordon Johnson
relations.evidence: and had been a Deputy Vice-Chancellor of the university from 2002 to 2010.

relations.subject: Gordon Johnson
relations.object: Royal Asiatic Society of Great Britain and Ireland
relations.evidence: He was the President of the Royal Asiatic Society of Great Britain and Ireland, 2015 to 2018 and is currently serving as the Vice President.
